description: This file defines the OA_XML_RPC_Client class, which extends PEAR::XML_RPC to enhance client HTTPS support, including SSL/TLS handling with cURL and OpenSSL, and manages HTTP/SOAP communication with a remote server.

classes.name: OA_XML_RPC_Client
classes.description: A class extending XML_RPC_Client to improve HTTPS support with SSL/TLS, cURL, and OpenSSL, including methods for sending HTTP requests over SSL and cURL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client, checks available SSL extensions, and sets default SSL verification and CA file.

methods.name: canUseSSL
methods.description: Returns true if either cURL or OpenSSL extensions are available for SSL support.

methods.name: _sendHttpGenerate
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers and credentials for the HTTP request.

methods.name: _sendHttpOpenSsl
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over SSL using stream context, handling timeouts and response parsing.

methods.name: _sendHttpCurl
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over SSL using cURL, handling timeouts and response parsing.

methods.name: sendPayloadHTTP10
methods.description: Chooses between cURL or OpenSSL methods to send HTTP payload, falling back to parent method if neither is available.
